# Milestone 1 — lesson vertical slice

<!-- AI-GENERATED by Claude (Claude Code), 2026-09-18 -->

One lesson, from JSON asset to a completed lesson that unlocks the next one,
through every layer the app will keep: domain models, repository interfaces,
Riverpod providers, go_router shell, two screens. **User writes every `lib/`
file; Claude tutors and reviews.** Placeholder content is fine; the point is
that the architecture holds before real content (M6), REST (M2), Firebase (M4)
and AI (M5) plug in behind the same interfaces.

Spec: `design/handoff/README.md` screens 5–8 (parcours, leçon explication, quiz
bonne/mauvaise réponse), "Interactions & Behavior", "State Management".
Screenshots: `design/handoff/screenshots/0{5,6,7,8}-*.png`. Product rules
(CLAUDE.md §3): lessons are data, four block types as a sealed union, one JSON
per unit under `assets/lessons/`, progress in memory for M1, no evaluation
engine. Microcopy is French, verbatim from the handoff, no emoji.

Out of scope here: Sensei panel and the « Pourquoi ? » link (M5), streak
computation (needs dates, M4), `drill` / `interactive` block bodies (M6),
Yaku / Scanner / Profil tab content (M2, M3, M4). They get empty variants or
placeholder screens only.

**Decided 2026-09-18:** lesson domain models (`lesson.dart`, `unit.dart`,
`lesson_block.dart`) go in `lib/shared/models/` next to `tile.dart`.

**Decided 2026-09-22 (flat feature folders):** every feature is one flat

  lesson_repository_impl.dart   # LessonRepositoryImpl (Task 3)
  lesson_asset_source.dart      # LessonAssetSource (Task 3)

lib/progress/                   # Task 4: user_progress.dart,

Role lives in the file suffix, not the folder, so the folder-name suffix
checks below do not fire; file/class match and privacy checks still apply.
Below, `lib/learning/…` is now literal. Only two things are fixed by the
conventions checker (`tool/check_conventions.dart`):

- folder *names* trigger suffix checks: `screens/` → `*_screen.dart` /
  `*Screen`; `repositories/` → `*_repository.dart` (interface) and
  `*_repository_impl.dart`; `sources/` → `*_source.dart`; `providers/` →
  `*_providers.dart`;
- a file is named after its primary class.

Progress (`ProgressRepository`, `UserProgress`) is used by the path screen and
later by Profil; put it where you want it shared from. `HomeScreen` and its
route die in Task 6; `TileGalleryScreen` and `/gallery` stay (debug).

## Lesson JSON schema (authored content, one file per unit)

```json
{
  "id": "unit_01",
  "title": "Lire les tuiles",
  "lessons": [
    {
      "id": "unit_01_lesson_01",
      "title": "Trois familles",
      "xp": 10,
      "blocks": [
        { "type": "explanation", "tile": "5p", "title": "…", "body": "…" },
        { "type": "quiz", "question": "…", "hand": ["1m", "2m", "…13 codes"],
          "options": ["…", "…", "…", "…"], "correctIndex": 2,
          "feedback": "…" },
        { "type": "drill" },
        { "type": "interactive" }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

Rules: `type` is the freezed union key; `hand` has 13 codes (`Tile.parse`
format, `5pr` for red five); `options` has exactly 4 entries (2×2 grid);
`feedback` is the one line shown in the green/vermillion panel; `tile` on an
explanation is the big demo tile. A unit with `"lessons": []` is authored but
not yet playable and renders as a locked node. XP is per lesson, in the data,
so no engine computes it.

## Tasks

Task state: `2026-09-18-lesson-slice.md.tasks.json` (same dir). Tasks 1, 2 and
4 are plain Dart; start there. Suggested first question: "how do I write a
freezed sealed union that reads `type` from JSON?"

### Task 1: Lesson domain (freezed)

Blocked by: none

**Goal:** Three value types. `LessonBlock` as `@Freezed(unionKey: 'type') sealed class` with four `const factory` variants: `explanation({required String tile, required String title, required String body})` → `ExplanationBlock`, `quiz({required String question, required List<String> hand, required List<String> options, required int correctIndex, required String feedback})` → `QuizBlock`, `drill()` → `DrillBlock`, `interactive()` → `InteractiveBlock`; `fromJson`. `Lesson({required String id, required String title, required int xp, required List<LessonBlock> blocks})` and `Unit({required String id, required String title, required List<Lesson> lessons})`, both `abstract class` + `const factory` + `fromJson`. Tiles stay strings in the model (`Tile.parse` happens in the widget), so content errors surface at render, not at load; `Tile` is not JSON-serialisable today and this keeps the domain free of the widget layer.
**Read:** CLAUDE.md freezed row; `~/.pub-cache/hosted/pub.dev/freezed_annotation-3.1.0/lib/freezed_annotation.dart` lines 282–330 (`unionKey`, `unionValueCase`; default value case is the constructor name, so `"type": "explanation"` needs no extra option).
**Acceptance:** `dart run build_runner build -d` emits `lesson_block.freezed.dart` + `.g.dart` and the same for `lesson`, `unit`; `LessonBlock.fromJson({'type': 'quiz', …})` returns a `QuizBlock`; a `switch (block)` over the four variants compiles with no `default`.
**Verify:** `dart run build_runner build -d && flutter analyze`

### Task 3: LessonRepository + asset source + impl

Blocked by: 1, 2

**Goal:** `abstract interface class LessonRepository { Future<List<Unit>> units(); Future<Lesson> lessonById(String id); }`. `LessonAssetSource` (constructor takes an `AssetBundle`, defaulting to `rootBundle`, so tests inject a fake) exposes `Future<List<Map<String, Object?>>> loadUnits()` reading a fixed list of asset paths (one const list in the source; no directory listing on device). `LessonRepositoryImpl(this._source)` maps JSON → `Unit.fromJson`, caches the list after first load, `lessonById` throws `ArgumentError` for an unknown id. Nothing else is public.
**Read:** `dart:convert` `jsonDecode`; `AssetBundle.loadString` in the file above; CLAUDE.md §4 privacy rules (`this._source`).
**Acceptance:** a throwaway `main()` or test prints six unit titles and lesson 1's block count = 3; `check_conventions` reports no new public-unused symbol besides what Task 5 will consume.
**Verify:** `flutter analyze && dart run tool/check_conventions.dart`

### Task 4: ProgressRepository + UserProgress + in-memory impl

Blocked by: 1

**Goal:** `UserProgress({required Set<String> completedLessonIds, required int xp})` freezed, with `bool isCompleted(String lessonId)`. `abstract interface class ProgressRepository { Future<UserProgress> load(); Future<UserProgress> completeLesson(Lesson lesson); }` — takes the `Lesson` so XP comes from the data. `InMemoryProgressRepository` holds one `UserProgress` field, starts empty, is idempotent (completing twice adds XP once). **Unlock rule as one pure top-level function** in the same file as `UserProgress`: `LessonStatus statusOf(Unit unit, int lessonIndex, UserProgress progress)` with `enum LessonStatus { completed, current, locked }` — lesson `i` is `completed` if in the set, `current` if `i == 0` or lesson `i-1` is completed, else `locked`. Unit-level: a unit is playable only if the previous unit's last lesson is completed and it has lessons. This is the whole "engine" M1 allows; keep it a function so tests hit it directly.
**Read:** CLAUDE.md §3 "Progress is Firestore's…" (M4 swaps this impl; the interface must not leak in-memory details).
**Acceptance:** `completeLesson` on a fresh repo returns `xp == lesson.xp`; second call same lesson leaves XP unchanged; `statusOf` on lesson 2 flips locked → current once lesson 1 is completed.
**Verify:** `dart run build_runner build -d && flutter analyze`

### Task 7: LessonPathScreen

Blocked by: 5, 6

**Amendment (2026-09-22):** the handoff shows **one node per unit**, not one
per lesson; built that way. Unit status comes from `unitStatusOf`, the
counter from `completedCount`, and a tap opens `lessonToOpen(unit, progress)`
(first `current` lesson, or the first lesson to replay a completed unit).

**Goal:** Handoff screen 5. Header row: streak (vermillion, shows `0` and a placeholder icon until M4), XP from `userProgressProvider`, settings icon (no action yet). Body: `ListView` of units **bottom-up** (`reverse: true`), each unit = title + its lessons as `_PathNode` circles: `completed` (bamboo fill + `Icons.check`), `current` (larger, ring, `"3/6"`-style counter = completed/total in the unit), `locked` (grey + `Icons.lock`). Status comes from `statusOf` (Task 4) and `unitsProvider` + `userProgressProvider`, pattern-matched on `AsyncData/AsyncLoading/AsyncError` (no generic spinner: loading = nothing or skeleton nodes; error = one line + retry that `ref.invalidate(unitsProvider)`). Tapping a `current` or `completed` node → `context.push(AppRoutes.lesson(lesson.id))`; locked does nothing. Colours and sizes from `AppColors` / `AppTokens` only; add tokens if a value is missing rather than writing a literal.
**Read:** handoff README screen 5 and `05-apprendre-parcours*.png`; CLAUDE.md §5 (`ref.watch` in build, `ref.read` in callbacks); `AppColors` fields (`bambooDeep`, `iconInactive`, `track`, `vermillionText`…).
